purpose.zh: 同时练伸髋和肩部上举，为桥做准备
purpose.en: Combine hip extension and overhead reach as prep for a full bridge.

text.zh: 手臂贴地伸过头，夹臀把髋顶起
text.en: Keep your arms long overhead on the floor and squeeze your glutes to lift

text.zh: 仰卧屈膝，双脚与髋同宽
text.en: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet hip-width apart.

text.zh: 肋骨下沉，顶端停住再慢慢放下
text.en: Keep your ribs down, hold at the top, then lower slowly.

commonErrors.en: Letting the arms lift off the floor.

cautions.zh: 肩部或腰部疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your shoulders or lower back hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
